commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Como are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90+3' Alvaro Morata (Como) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+3' Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' The Lecce players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+1' Alvaro Morata (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

86' He should have scored! Assane Diao (Como) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Wladimiro Falcone makes an easy save.
84' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Jesus Rodriguez is replaced by Assane Diao (Como).
84' It will be a substitution. Gaby Jean (Lecce) is ready to enter the pitch as Tiago Gabriel walks off.
79' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lecce get a corner.
78' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lecce out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
77' The game has come to an end for Anastasios Douvikas. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alvaro Morata (Como).
74' Como are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) replaces Lameck Banda.
71' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
70' Lameck Banda (Lecce) serves up a nice cross, but Jean Butez punches the ball away.
69' Lecce are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
68' Nico Paz (Como) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
65' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Mergim Vojvoda and he is replaced by Nico Paz (Como).
64' The substitution has been made. Sergi Roberto (Como) has replaced Maximo Perrone.

63' What a miss! The corner finds Anastasios Douvikas (Como) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
62' The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
61' Lameck Banda (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francesco Fourneau stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
61' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:0.
61' The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
59' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Walid Cheddira will be replaced by Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
59' Substitution. Oumar Ngom (Lecce) on for Omri Gandelman.
55' Maxence Caqueret (Como) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
53' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
51' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
50' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Half-time substitution. Corrie Ndaba is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Diego Carlos (Como) and Marc Oliver Kempf is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 3 - 1 Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 3:1.
43' Como have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
41' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
39' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
38' Lecce have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
35' 2 - 1 Jesus Rodriguez (Como) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
34' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Fourneau saw the whole situation.
32' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
32' The game is interrupted now, Walid Cheddira (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
29' Como hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
28' A corner kick by Como is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
27' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Maxence Caqueret (Como) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
24' The linesman makes the right call and Como will have a corner.
23' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Now Como have a corner.
22' Maxence Caqueret (Como) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
21' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Francesco Fourneau signals a set piece.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 79:21.
18' 1 - 1 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
17' A great solo run by Jesus Rodriguez (Como) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Wladimiro Falcone.
15' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
13' 0 - 1 What a finish that is! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) latches on to a brilliant cross and gets his head on the ball to put it inside the right post. No chance of stopping that.
12' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
4' Francesco Fourneau couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) and blew his whistle.
4' An attempted cross from Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is cleared.
